# laravelforge_database (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge database (schema) by ID on a server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the database.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the database belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Database (schema) name.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
